args.sql: SELECT category_l1 AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN item_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_current, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN item_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_previous, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS units_current, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS units_previous, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN item_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN units ELSE 0 END), 0) AS price_current, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN item_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN units ELSE 0 END), 0) AS price_previous FROM default_catalog.ec_dw.dws_category_daily WHERE category_l1 = '家电' GROUP BY category_l1
